messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool latency spike detected for account 'sapphire-financial' (sapph-001). metric=dedicated.p95.latency, value=1.4s, threshold=1.2s. Route: pager -> erin-oncall.

erin-oncall: ack. I'm taking the page. starting triage now. @javier can you pull recent autoscaler/queue logs?

javier-sre: pulling logs, attaching quick grep output:
```
./logs/queue-processor.log: 2026-02-28T11:12:30Z WARN batch_size=128 process_time=1400ms
./logs/autoscaler.log: 2026-02-28T11:11:58Z INFO scale_up_request id=az-7 pending=3
```

maya-runtime: seeing transient kernel queue buildup on nodes in us-west-2a. KV cache hit rates look normal. suspect batching blowup from one high-throughput customer route.

erin-oncall: ok, put sapphire routing on reduced batch window and pin to lower-batch model variant as a temporary mitigation. Can someone run the rollback command? `rwdctl scale policy set --pool sapphire-prod --batch-window 50ms`

javier-sre: applied batch-window change and rolled routing policy to sapphire-prod-limited. latency p95 dropping to ~900ms now. continuing observation.

lina-csm: pinging Sapphire account team (cc @tom-am). They just reported perceived slowness in their internal dashboard at ~11:10PT. Any ETA for full restoration?

erin-oncall: current ETA ~10-15m if metrics continue to trend. mitigation = routing to lower-batch + temporary increase in capacity by +2 nodes. planning a customer-facing status blurb.

tom-am: thanks. please include tailored impact: "Customers on Sapphire Financial dedicated pool may have observed delayed responses (median +200-1200ms) for background batch jobs and interactive lookups between 11:05–11:25 PT. No data loss, requests completed, and fallbacks to lower-throughput variant applied."

status-bot: Draft status page update queued: "We are investigating elevated latency for the Sapphire Financial dedicated inference pool in us-west-2. Mitigations in progress; some requests may experience higher-than-normal response times. We will post an update within 30 minutes." Would you like me to post now?

erin-oncall: post it now, mark impact: "Partial degraded performance" and add estimated next update at +30m.

status-bot: Posted status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3267894321 - Impact: Partial degraded performance, Affected: Sapphire Financial (sapph-001).

javier-sre: double-checking autoscaler logs — scale-up worked but one node had GPU memory fragmentation causing slower batches. warming a replacement node now.

maya-runtime: replacement node healthy, traffic draining from impacted node. p95 now ~650ms, error rate unchanged. recommend keeping reduced-batch routing for 20m then gradual revert.

erin-oncall: agreed. I'll keep oncall until stable and coordinate handoff if needed. Lina, please prepare the tailored customer notification using Tom's wording and include the operational note about no data loss.

lina-csm: Draft for customer message: "We experienced elevated response times on your dedicated inference pool between 11:05–11:25 PT. We applied routing and capacity mitigations; median latency has returned to acceptable levels. No requests were dropped and there was no data loss. Our SREs will monitor for 2 hours and follow up with a short root-cause summary." Approve?

tom-am: approve, send from acct-notify@sapphire.redwood.ai and cc customer success inbox. Include contact routing: urgent escalation -> Tom (primary) -> Lina -> Engineering oncall.

erin-oncall: creating a short internal postmortem stub in the incident tracker. tagging `sapphire-prod` and `dedicated-autoscaler`. I'll hand off in 30m if stable.

status-bot: Next status update scheduled at 30 minutes.

erin-oncall: thanks team. keeping thread open for 1hr post-stable. :white_check_mark:
